rows.title: Audit Manager
rows.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION หน้าที่ความรับผิดชอบ

  • ร่วมกำหนดแนวทางและประเมินความเสี่ยงเพื่อจัดลำดับความสำคัญของกระบวนการทำงานของบริษัท (Audit Universe) พร้อมทั้งร่วมกับกลุ่มงานพัฒนาการตรวจสอบภายในและบริหารทั่วไปในการจัดทำแผนการตรวจสอบเชิงกลยุทธ์และแผนการตรวจสอบประจำปี
  • สนับสนุนข้อมูลและร่วมพิจารณาแผนการตรวจสอบเพื่อปรับปรุงระหว่างปีให้เหมาะสมกับความเสี่ยงและการเปลี่ยนแปลงของปัจจัยต่างๆ ที่มีผลกระทบสำคัญ
  • วางแผน กำกับดูแล ติดตามและสอบทานการจัดทำแผนการตรวจสอบในรายละเอียด ซึ่งรวมถึงแผนปฏิบัติงานตรวจสอบและแนวการตรวจสอบ (Audit Program) สำหรับกระบวนการสนับสนุนธุรกิจ (Business Support) และกระบวนการด้านเทคโนโลยีสารสนเทศ ตามแผนการตรวจสอบประจำปี
  • ร่วมวางแผน ควบคุมและกำกับดูแลการปฏิบัติงานของทีมงานตรวจสอบในกระบวนการตรวจสอบกระบวนการสนับสนุนธุรกิจ (Business Support) และกระบวนการด้านเทคโนโลยีสารสนเทศเพื่อให้ความมั่นใจในความถูกต้อง เชื่อถือได้ของข้อมูลทางการเงินและการดำเนินงาน ประสิทธิภาพประสิทธิผลของกระบวนการทำงาน รวมทั้งการปฏิบัติตามนโยบาย วิธีปฏิบัติงาน กฎหมาย ระเบียบและข้อบังคับที่เกี่ยวข้อง
  • ตรวจสอบตามหัวข้อในแนวการตรวจสอบ (Audit Program) ที่ได้รับ
  • กำกับดูแล ให้คำแนะนำการปฏิบัติงานตามหัวข้อในแนวการตรวจสอบ (Audit Program)
  • สอบทานกระดาษทำการและสอบทานร่างรายงานการตรวจสอบ
  • กำกับดูแล จัดทำและสอบทาน รวมถึงประเมินประเด็นที่ตรวจพบเพื่อนำมาจัดทำร่างรายงานการตรวจสอบ
  • ประชุมปิดการตรวจสอบกับผู้บริหารระดับสูงของหน่วยงานรับตรวจ และสอบทานบันทึกการประชุม
  • ติดตามและสอบทานเพื่อออกรายงานการตรวจสอบฉบับสมบูรณ์
  • ติดตามและสอบทานการจัดทำรายงานประเด็นสำคัญที่ตรวจพบเพื่อรายงานคณะกรรมการตรวจสอบ
  • สอบทาน ติดตามผล และประเมินความเพียงพอของการปฏิบัติตามข้อเสนอแนะ และการรายงานความคืบหน้าผลการดำเนินการ
  • ให้คำปรึกษารวมถึงสนับสนุนข้อมูล ด้านการบริหารความเสี่ยง การควบคุมภายใน และการกำกับดูแลแก่ผู้บริหารและหน่วยงานต่างๆ
  • ปฏิบัติงานตรวจสอบพิเศษตามแนวทางที่ได้รับมอบหมาย
  • ปฏิบัติหน้าที่อื่นๆ ตามที่ได้รับมอบหมาย


QUALIFICATION คุณสมบัติของผู้สมัคร

คุณสมบัติทั่วไป

  • ชาย หรือ หญิง สัญชาติไทย ผู้สมัครเพศชายต้องผ่านการเกณฑ์ทหารแล้ว
  • อายุ 25- 45 ปีบริบูรณ์ นับถึงวันที่บริษัทมีประกาศรับสมัคร
  • วุฒิการศึกษาระดับปริญญาตรีไม่จำกัดสาขา หรือหากสำเร็จในสาขาที่เกี่ยวข้องกับหน้าที่ความรับผิดชอบจะเป็นประโยชน์ในการพิจารณา
  • มีความรู้ ความสามารถในการใช้ภาษาอังกฤษทั้งการฟัง พูด อ่านและเขียน โดยมีผลการทดสอบข้อเขียนภาษาอังกฤษ Test of English for International Communication (TOEIC) ประเภทบุคคลทั่วไป (Personal) ไม่น้อยกว่า 600 คะแนน หรือ THAI Test of English Proficiency (THAI-TEP) ไม่น้อยกว่า 59 คะแนน ทั้งนี้ ผลการทดสอบดังกล่าวต้องไม่เกิน 2 ปี นับจากวันที่สอบ (Test Date) ถึงวันที่ยื่นใบสมัคร และต้องแสดงผลภายในกำหนดเวลาที่รับสมัคร
  • ต้องมีวุฒิบัตรหรือเป็นผู้สอบบัญชีรับอนุญาต (Certificated Public Accountant : CPA) หรือ มีการฝึกหัดงานสอบบัญชีเป็นเวลาต่อเนื่อง ไม่น้อยกว่า 3 ปี แต่ไม่เกิน 5 ปี นับจากวันยื่นคำขอแจ้งการฝึกหัดงาน และมีเวลาฝึกหัดงานรวมกันไม่น้อยกว่า 3,000 ชั่วโมง


คุณสมบัติเฉพาะตำแหน่งงาน

  • มีความรอบรู้ในธุรกิจขององค์กรและธุรกิจการบิน
  • มีความรู้ในเรื่องกฎ ระเบียบ ทั้งของบริษัท หน่วยงานราชการ และ/หรือองค์กรการบินสากลอื่นๆ ที่เกี่ยวข้อง
  • มีความรู้และความเข้าใจเกี่ยวกับมาตรฐานสากลการปฏิบัติงานวิชาชีพการตรวจสอบภายใน
  • หากมีวุฒิบัตรทางวิชาชีพการตรวจสอบภายในเช่น Certified Professional Internal Audit of Thailand (CPIAT) , Internal Audit Certificate Program (IACP) , Certified Internal Auditor (CIA) , Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) เป็นต้น จะเป็นประโยชน์ในการพิจารณา
  • มีความรู้และประสบการณ์ในงานบริหารความเสี่ยง การควบคุมภายใน และการกำกับดูแล
  • มีความสามารถในการประมวลผล การคิดวิเคราะห์อย่างเป็นระบบและการสรุปรายงาน
  • มีทักษะการสื่อสาร ถ่ายทอดข้อมูล และให้คำปรึกษาแนะนำ และแก้ไขปัญหาที่มีประสิทธิผล
  • มีความละเอียด รอบคอบ มีความเป็นอิสระ เที่ยงธรรม และเก็บรักษาความลับได้
  • มีทักษะในการโน้มน้าว สร้างความเชื่อถือและเป็นที่ยอมรับของผู้ร่วมปฏิบัติงานในทุกระดับทั้งภายในและภายนอกหน่วยงาน
  • มีทัศนคติ มนุษยสัมพันธ์ดี และมีภาวะผู้นำ
  • มีหลักและเทคนิคการบริหารงานแบบมุ่งผลสัมฤทธิ์
  • มีทักษะในการเขียนรายงาน และการนำเสนอ (Presentation)
  • มีความสามารถในการใช้งานภาษาอังกฤษในระดับดี

company.name: Lalamove
company.introduction:
Lalamove is an on-demand delivery technology company, empowering users all around the world to make delivery fast and reliable.

Today, Lalamove operates in 11 markets across Asia and Latin America. Our driver partners operate a vast array of vehicles to suit each market including lorries, vans and cars for deliveries of almost anything of any size. Fleets of two-wheel vehicles are also available for courier services providing fast and low-cost delivery solutions. Through dedicated mobile and web apps, Lalamove seamlessly connects users and drivers around the world to move things that matter.

As one of Hong Kong’s homegrown unicorn startups, we are proud to employ some of the most passionate, talented and driven people in the industry. If you have the drive to succeed, make your next move at Lalamove!

rows.title: Driver Operations Team Lead
rows.description:
What You’ll Do


  • Recruitment of quality Fleet management drivers into the fleet.

  • Provide training to Fleet management drivers/vendors.
  • Planning and managing logistics, transportation, and customer services.
  • Keep track of quality, quantity, delivery times, transport costs, and efficiency.
  • Resolve any arising problems or complaints to ensure customer satisfaction.
  • Identifying operational requirements and opportunities for improvement.
  • Develop new processes and procedures to enhance recruitment and operations processes.
  • Creative problem-solving, strong critical thinking, and a get-things-done mentality.
  • Participates in meetings and presentations.
  • Able to travel and work upcountry.


What You’ll Need


  • At least 5 years experience in Supply Chain or Fleet management service
  • Good command in English (Reading, Speaking, Writing & Listening)
  • Require skills in Communication, Collaboration, and Presentation
  • Rationale thinking & good teamwork
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Detail-oriented with coordination skills
  • Work experience in Operations, Logistics, Project Management, or related roles.
  • Computer skills (Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Microsoft Project), advanced in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint are a must.

company.name: Lenskart
company.introduction: Lenskart is Asia’s largest eyewear company serving 40 Million people - helping them see better and lead better quality lives. We have more than 1500 omnichannel stores across 175 cities in India, Singapore and Dubai. Our aim is to serve One Billion eyes by 2025 globally. And in this journey, we want to go beyond vision correction to transform the way people see and experience the world. That’s our new purpose - and we can only get there through cutting-edge technology and exceptional people.

rows.title: Store Manager
rows.description:
Responsibilities:

  • Store Operations: Managing all aspects of store operations, including opening and closing procedures, cash handling, inventory management, and maintaining store cleanliness and organization.
  • Sales and Profitability: Achieve sales targets, monitoring performance, and implementing strategies to achieve sales goals. Analyzing sales data and identifying opportunities for growth. Monitoring expenses and proposing cost control measures to maximize profitability.
  • Team Management: Implement training programs, and supervising store staff. Setting performance expectations and providing ongoing feedback. Scheduling shifts and managing payroll. Motivating and engaging employees to ensure a high level of customer service.
  • Customer Service: Ensuring exceptional customer service standards are met by the store staff. Handling customer inquiries, complaints, and resolving any issues that may arise. Creating a positive shopping experience for customers and building customer loyalty.
  • Merchandising and Visual Presentation: Overseeing product placement and visual displays to optimize sales and create an appealing shopping environment as per company policy
  • Marketing and Promotions: Collaborating with the marketing team to implement marketing campaigns and promotional activities. Monitoring the effectiveness of marketing initiatives and providing feedback to Retail leader
  • Safety and Security: Ensuring compliance with safety and security procedures. Implementing loss prevention measures to minimize theft and protect company assets.
  • Store Policies and Procedures: Enforcing company policies and procedures. Keeping up to date with industry trends and implementing best practices to enhance store operations.
  • Relationship Management: Building and maintaining positive relationships with customers, suppliers, and vendors. Collaborating with other departments, such as human resources, to ensure effective communication and coordination.


Requirements:

  • Previous experience in retail, such as assistant manager or supervisor roles, is a must .
  • Retail Knowledge and Skills: Minimum 5 years in retail industry with minimum 3 years in the Store Manager role. Understanding of retail operations, sales techniques, merchandising, and customer service principles. Familiarity with inventory management and retail software.
  • Leadership and Management Skills: Ability to effectively manage and motivate a team, provide clear communication and feedback, delegate tasks, and solve problems.
  • Sales and Business Acumen: Proven track record in achieving sales targets, analyzing sales data, and implementing strategies for growth. Financial management skills and knowledge of budgeting and profitability analysis.
  • Customer Service Focus: Commitment to exceptional customer service, handling inquiries and complaints, and building customer relationships.
  • Organizational and Time Management Skills: Strong organizational skills to manage store operations, inventory, and staff scheduling. Ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines.
  • Problem-Solving and Decision-Making Abilities: Ability to identify and resolve issues, think critically, and make sound decisions.
  • Flexibility and Adaptability: Willingness to work flexible hours, including weekends and holidays. Adaptability to changing circumstances and multitasking effectively.

rows.title: Cook Helper-Cold
rows.description:
What will I be doing?

As a Cook, you are responsible for preparing and presenting high quality dishes to deliver an excellent Guest and Member experience. A Cook will also be required to prepare all mis-en-place and contribute to departmental targets. Specifically, you will be responsible for performing the following tasks to the highest standards:

  • Prepare and present high quality dishes within company guidelines
  • Keep all working areas clean and tidy and ensure no cross contamination
  • Prepare all mis-en-place for all relevant menus
  • Assist other departments wherever necessary and maintain good working relationships
  • Report maintenance, hygiene and hazard issues
  • Comply with hotel security, fire regulations and all health and safety and food safety legislation
  • Awareness of departmental targets and strive to achieve them as part of the team
  • Be environmentally aware


What are we looking for?

A Cook serving Hilton brands is always working on behalf of our Guests and working with other Team Members. To successfully fill this role, you should maintain the attitude, behaviours, skills, and values that follow:

  • NVQ Level 1
  • Positive attitude
  • Good communication skills
  • Ability to work under pressure
  • Ability to work on own or in teams


It would be advantageous in this position for you to demonstrate the following capabilities and distinctions:

  • NVQ Level 2
  • Previous kitchen experience in similar role
  • Basic food hygiene

rows.title: Information Technology Auditor
rows.description:
Responsibilities:

  • Prepare IT audit plans and organize workflows according to personnel capability/workload (IT control objectives/IT audit program)
  • Conduct IT audits in accordance with the principles of internal control in IT control/ application control/general computer control (GCC) & business computer control (BCC) and IT risk control by providing feedback on internal control that is concise and appropriate
  • Review the preparation of audit reports and supervise the storage of audit documents in accordance with the established principles
  • Coordinate with external auditors or external agencies responsible for supervising the company, including reviewing observations/recommendations of internal/external auditors


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in computer business, statistics, corporate governance, accounting, finance, business administration or related fields
  • At least 5 years' experience in IT audit or IT related areas
  • Understand the basic of IT applications (Audit software/Audit tools)
  • Effective communication skills in English (speaking, reading, and writing)
  • High experience in using Microsoft Office suites (Excel, PowerPoint, and Word)
  • Hold any internal auditors certificate (CIA or CISA) will be an advantage

rows.title: Portfolio Marketing Manager
rows.description:
Responsibilities:

  • Manage and analyze personal loan portfolios efficiently and generate growth regarding to the targets/company’s KPI (Personal Loans Portfolio Management)
  • Analyze data on personal loan consumer behavior and understand the needs of members in each targeted group directly (Customer Behavior Analysis)
  • Determine strategies and marketing plans that are suitable for each target group effectively (Marketing Plan and Segmentation Strategy)
  • Set up marketing campaigns that are related to the established strategy (Marketing Campaign Execution), and make sure to monitor and evaluate the success of each project (Campaign Monitoring and Evaluation) in a long run
  • Develop personal loan products and services to be competitive in the market and meet the needs of members efficiently (Product Features and Services Enhancement)

rows.title: Data Scientist
rows.description:
About the role

TAO BIN has become a household name in Thailand with thousands of machines deployed throughout the country and hundreds-of-thousands of cups sold per day. Behind these machines is a powerful data platform (vendii) that automatically knows when to refill the machines, what to refill the machines with and provides operators with a suite of tools – monitoring, alerting, analytics, to manage operations at scale. TAO BIN’s growth has been stratospheric and, with no signs of slowing down, next year we are going international. As such, we are looking for a talented data scientist.


Our team, originally from the acquisition of vendii, is a looking to operate upwards of 100,000 machines worldwide over the next 4 years. We are building the best-in-class platform for vending operations, realised as an event sourced distributed system integrating directly with IoT machines in real-time. Areas you’ll be working on include demand forecasting, replenishment optimisation, recommendation systems, route optimisation, customer vitals analysis and so much more! There are many opportunities and being a greenfield project means there is latitude for you to have a tremendous influence on the direction of the product. 


Requirement 

  • Excellent analytical skills.
  • Strong intuition of Machine Learning and corresponding mathematics.
  • Strong coding skills in Python, Python’s popular libraries and scientific stack.
  • Experience with modern ML/AI tools/libraries/platforms, data processing in, ETL, feature engineering and MLOps (tuning models in training and production).
  • End-to-end experience, from business requirements through to productionising models and pipeline creation.

Desirable Skills

  • Masters or PhD in a STEM (science, technology, engineer mathematics) field.
  • Experience with SQL
  • Practical research experience.
  • Software developer experience.

rows.title: Senior Software Engineer
rows.description:
About the role

  • Impactful Work: As a Senior Backend Engineer, you'll play a crucial role in building and architecting distributed services that directly influence experience and operational efficiency.
  • Technologies: Work with TypeScript, Python, Golang, PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka, RabbitMQ, Docker, AWS products (lambdas, ECS, etc) and more. We build high throughput event driven systems and you'll tackle challenges in scaling, data management, and system reliability.
  • Collaboration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to build scalable backend systems. Your work will be integral to our product development and operational strategies.


What We Offer

  • Culture & Values: At TAO BIN, we pride ourselves on a culture of innovation, respect, and collaboration. We're committed to fostering an inclusive environment where every team member's contribution is valued.
  • Professional Growth: Continuous learning is part of our ethos. We support professional development through training programs, workshops, and conference attendance.
  • Diversity & Inclusion: We believe diverse perspectives lead to better ideas and outcomes. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds to contribute to our inclusive workplace.


Requirements

  • Strong computer science fundamentals and at least 2 years’ experience in building distributed systems.
  • Proficiency in TypeScript, Python, Golang or similar technologies.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with database management experience (SQL, NoSQL).
  • Familiarity with clean architecture, SOLID principles, and domain-driven design.
  • Knowledge of event-driven systems, event driven or messaging systems (Kafka) and cloud platforms (AWS).
  • Possess outstanding verbal and written communication skills in both English and Thai.


It’s Great If You Have

  • Expertise in Security Best Practices
  • Experienced in Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
  • Familiarity with CQRS.
  • Proactive problem-solving attitude.
  • Familiar with Serverless Architectures (AWS Lambda).
  • Experienced in working with GraphQL.

rows.title: [TH] Sales Engineer - BytePlus
rows.description:
Responsibilities

  • Partner with regional Sales Teams to qualify leads, identify client's pain points and create technical solutions that eventually deliver business results to clients
  • Externally, call upon technical expertise and business acumen to lead the enterprise client engagement (C-level to working level) lifecycle end-to-end, from pre-sales solutioning to delivering project implementation. Activities include demos, presentations, RFI/RFP, architecture design workshops & POC delivery.
  • Internally, act as trusted advisor collaborating with multiple product teams and articulate clear feature requests to shape product roadmap in both short- and long-term. Provide Thought Leadership, Industry Knowledge, and deep understanding across multiple cloud and ML products.
  • Maintain post-sales solution support and drive upsell/cross-sell together with Account Executives.


Qualifications

  • Engineering Bachelor degree and above;
  • At least 7 years of related work experience, preferably in the role of solution architect or pre-sales solution engineering;
  • Demonstrate strong strategic thinking and analytical skills by explaining relevant past projects in the technical interview rounds;
  • Product-wise, preferably have deep understanding in Public Cloud, including but not limited to:
  • edge network (CDN) and security (WAF, DDoS),
  • video streaming - Livestream solution end-to-end, RTC, VOD
  • and ML applications (ML Recommend, computer vision, NLP, generative AI)
  • Industry-wise, preferably have worked with large enterprise clients in verticals like Retail, Media, Entertainment, Gaming, etc
  • Basic to advanced developer skills can be a plus:
  • Front-end dev with web (JS & JS frameworks) and native apps (iOS & Android)
  • Back-end micro service architecture knowledge and server-side API integration
  • Hands-on experience building Deep Learning models
  • Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal
  • Comfortable with fast-paced and ambiguous "startup" environment
  • Can-Do attitude, Self-starter, Ability to work independently and highly motivated with contagious enthusiasm;
  • Team player and able to foster positive team morale, to set goals and drive for successful fulfilment;
  • Gives attention to Details as much as to the "Bigger Picture"; Can synthetize.

rows.title: Shift Staff (Engineer)_Power & Utility
rows.description:
Responsibilities


  • To ensure all facility installation comply with local authorization legal requirements.
  • To work closely with Safety & Health team on daily maintenance work to comply with OSH, environmental standards and industry codes of practice.
  • To plan and manage plant facilities systems PM activities such as Electrical Power System (transformers, switchgears, electrical DBs, Standby Genset), Compressors, Boilers, Air Cond, Chillers & Fire Protection System to minimized unplanned downtime.
  • Conduct daily facilities inspections and escalate to superior for any irregularities or non-conformities.
  • Perform the functional requirement of DOSH, DOE, Bomba, ST Acts and related regulations for steam boiler, pressure vessels, energy or electrical systems management.
  • During emergency, to assess and switch off power supply at substations if found necessary (chargeman only)
  • Provide regular update on Facilities Systems Maintenance Status to Management timely and regularly.
  • To prepare reports as required by the management.
  • Liaise with Production and other departments/ section related to activities that will be affecting common facilities such as Electrical System Shut down, Fire Fighting Systems Testing & others.
  • Manage contractors on site so that they comply to Environment, Health and Safety policy during implementation of facility installation and utilities hook up.
  • Maintain and forecast on critical parts and consumables.
  • Monitoring of energy usage efficiency as well as propose & implement energy saving projects and cost reduction.
  • Improves function and reliability of facility equipment by studying performance results, identifying, recommending, and implementing changes, expansions, and additions.
  • Prepare budgets for power/ utilities facility maintenance and upgrades.
  • Participate in Kaizen activities.
  • Ability to manage project, tasks on time with very little supervision.
  • To perform part of the Senior Engineer function in his absence as deem fit by superior.
  • Undertake any other projects, tasks and duties as assigned by superiors from time to time.

rows.title: Compliance Senior Manager (ACSS)
rows.location: Suan Luang district, Bangkok City, Thailand
rows.description:
Key Responsibilities:


  • ศึกษาและวิเคราะห์กฎหมายที่เกี่ยวข้องกับธุรกิจของ ACSS รวมถึงประมวลจริยธรรมและนโยบายต่าง ๆ ของ AFS และ AEONTS และนำมาประยุกต์ใช้กับ ACSS
  • บริหารจัดการให้หน่วยงานต่าง ๆ ประเมินความเสี่ยงด้าน Compliance และติดตามหรือสอบทานผลการประเมินความเสี่ยงดังกล่าว เพื่อให้แน่ใจว่าไม่มีการปฏิบัติผิดกฎหมายหรือกฎระเบียบภายในที่มีนัยสำคัญ
  • สอบสวนพนักงาน สืบหาข้อเท็จจริงและหลักฐาน ร่วมวางกรอบกระบวนการสอบสวนในแต่เรื่อง ให้คำแนะนำและเป็นสมาชิกหลัก Disciplinary Working Team
  • จัดทำรายงาน Whistle Blowing ประสานงานและให้ข้อมูลที่ครบถ้วนตามแบบฟอร์มที่ AFS กำหนด
  • ให้ความเห็นประเด็นทางกฎหมายและ Compliance เกี่ยวกับกิจกรรมและการดำเนินงานต่าง ๆ ของบริษัท
  • ตรวจสอบ สอบทานและให้ความเห็นเกี่ยวกับเอกสารทางกฎหมายของบริษัทตามทีได้รับมอบหมาย เช่น สัญญา หนังสือ จดหมายชี้แจง หนังสือมอบอำนาจ เป็นต้น
  • เป็นตัวกลางประสานงานกับตัวแทนของฝ่ายที่เกี่ยวข้องในประเด็นที่พระราชบัญญัติคุ้มครองข้อมูลส่วนบุคคล พ.ศ.2562 ตลอดจนควบคุมและติดตามความเสี่ยงของประเด็นปัญหาต่างๆ พร้อมทั้ง นำเสนอแนวทางการควบคุมจัดการความเสี่ยง (risk mitigation)
  • บริหารจัดการความเสี่ยงขั้นพื้นฐาน PDCA, วางแผนงบประมาณ และแผนประจำปีระดับแผนกสำหรับงานด้าน Risk Management และวิเคราะห์ประสิทธิภาพของการจัดการความเสี่ยงโดยการตรวจสอบภายในหรือหน่วยงานที่เกี่ยวข้องและทำการประเมินประสิทธิภาพ
  • ติดตาม และควบคุมให้หน่วยงายมีการบันทึกเหตุละเมิด
  • บริหารจัดการงานโครงการพิเศษต่าง ๆ ตามที่ได้รับมอบหมายจากหัวหน้าฝ่าย


Requirements:


  • ผู้สมัครที่มีอายุตั้งแต่ 35 ปีขึ้นไป
  • จบการศึกษาตั้งแต่ระดับปริญญาตรีขึ้นไป จากสาขานิติศาสตร์ หรือสาขาอื่น ๆ ที่เกี่ยวข้อง
  • มีประสบการณ์ด้านงานกฎหมาย งานกำกับและบริหารความเสี่ยง (Compliance & Risk Management) ตั้งแต่ 6 ปีขึ้นไป
  • มีทักษะในการติดต่อสื่อสาร มีทักษะในการติดต่อสื่อสาร และการแก้ไขปัญหาเฉพาะหน้าได้ดี
  • มีประสบการณ์ในด้านงานบริหารและการดูแลพนักงานภายใต้การบังคับบัญชา
  • สามารถสื่อสารภาษาอังกฤษได้ในระดับดี

  • Direct Taxes Process

  • Problem solving and analytical skills
  • Adaptability

ONE is the world’s largest martial arts organization, featuring the greatest world champion martial artists on Earth across Muay Thai, Mixed Martial Arts, Kickboxing, Submission Grappling, and more. Headquartered in Singapore, ONE is Asia's largest billion dollar global sports media property with a worldwide broadcast to over 190+ countries.


According to Nielsen, ONE ranks amongst the world’s top 10 biggest sports media properties (alongside NBA, Champions League, EPL, F1, etc) in terms of viewership and engagement. Through its marquee sports property, ONE Championship, and its passionate millennial community, ONE is a celebration of Asia’s greatest cultural treasure, Martial Arts, and its deep-rooted values of integrity, humility, honor, respect, courage, discipline, and compassion. As the world's largest martial arts organization, ONE is on a mission to unleash real-life superheroes, tell stories, celebrate values, ignite dreams, inspire nations, and change the world.

  • Strong organizational skills to manage workflow and meet deadlines


Language Requirements

  • Perfect command of Thai
  • Business-level command of English

rows.title: Duty Manager
rows.location: Renaissance Bangkok Ratchaprasong Hotel, 518/8 Ploenchit Road, Bangkok, Thailand

Compile and review daily reports/logs/contingency lists. Complete cashier and closing reports. Supply guests with directions and property information. Accommodate guest requests, contacting appropriate staff if necessary. Follow up to ensure requests have been met. Process all payment types, vouchers, paid-outs, and charges. Balance and drop receipts. Count and secure bank at beginning and end of shift. Obtain manual authorizations and follow all Accounting procedures. Notify Loss Prevention/Security of any guest reports of theft.


Assist management in training, evaluating, counseling, motivating and coaching employees; serve as a role model and first point of contact of the Guarantee of Fair Treatment/Open Door Policy process. Develop/maintain positive working relationships; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to employee concerns. Follow company policies and procedures; report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications; ensure personal appearance is clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge guests; anticipate and address guests’ service needs; assist individuals with disabilities; thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak using clear and professional language; prepare and review written documents accurately and completely; answer telephones using appropriate etiquette. Ensure adherence to quality standards. Enter and locate information using computers/POS systems. Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

rows.title: Server
rows.location: Renaissance Bangkok Ratchaprasong Hotel, 518/8 Ploenchit Road, Bangkok, Thailand
rows.description:
Position Summary


Our jobs aren’t just about putting food on the table that our guests will enjoy until they ask for their bill. Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique – with food and drinks on the side. Our Guest Service Experts take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests enjoy their meal. Whether setting tables, communicating with the kitchen, interacting and serving guests, or cleaning work areas and supplies, the Guest Service Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.


No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success – creating a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional. Guest Service Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time; moving over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces), managing the menu (read and visually verify information), and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance and 50 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping). Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Service Experts – to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.


Preferred Qualifications


Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.


Related Work Experience: Less than 1 year related work experience.


Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.


License or Certification: None

  • Manages assigned accounts as per the media account management system
  • Manages external vendors and media agencies; work with agency partners to identify strategic media buys for their hotel(s)
  • Liaises with continent PR leadership to ensure media placement for hotel(s) supports the overall hotel marketing strategy
  • Acts as consulting resource for property marketing teams looking for regional photographers for food, amenity, and property imagery and ensures all photography adheres to brand voice


Regional Marketing Activation Tracking

  • Assists with ensuring departmental orientation processes are in place and employees receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.

  • Assists in maintaining effective employee communication channels in the property (e.g., develops daily communications and assists with regularly scheduled property-wide meetings).

  • High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the human resources, management operations, or related professional area.

Key Responsibilities:


• Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements and define reporting objectives, KPIs, and metrics aligned with business goals.

• Design and develop scalable and user-friendly BI dashboards and reports using tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Looker.

• Build and optimize data pipelines and ETL processes to extract, transform, and load data from various sources into our reporting systems.

• Perform data analysis and visualization to identify trends, patterns, and insights that inform strategic decision-making and drive business outcomes.

• Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and consistency by implementing data validation checks and quality assurance processes.

• Proactively monitor and troubleshoot reporting issues, identify root causes, and implement solutions to enhance performance and reliability.

• Stay abreast of emerging trends and best practices in reporting and BI technologies, and recommend innovative solutions to improve efficiency and effectiveness.

• Collaborate with internal teams and external clients to provide training and support on reporting tools and methodologies, fostering a culture of data-driven decision-making.


Qualifications:


• Thai Nationality

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business Analytics, or related field.

• Proven experience as a Reporting/BI Engineer or similar role, with hands-on experience in designing and building BI dashboards and reports.

• Proficiency in SQL, Python, or other programming languages for data manipulation and analysis.

• Strong knowledge of BI tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar platforms.

• Experience with data modeling, ETL processes, and data warehousing concepts.

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.

• Prior experience in the fintech industry or related domains is a plus.

company.name: Steps
company.introduction:
Steps provides access to meaningful and appropriate transition to employment pathways for the neurodivergent community.


Steps models inclusive and sustainable businesses such as coffee shops, retail shops, business outsource services, and bakeries.


Steps empowers employers to begin their inclusion journey with our inclusion diagnostic tools, disability inclusive accreditation awards, and consultancy.

rows.title: Inclusion Specialist / Inclusion Teacher
rows.description:
Job Title: Senior Job Coach/Inclusion Teacher (Experienced)

BU: Inclusive Education

Responsible to: Head of Education


Work hours: 7:30am – 4:30pm (Monday-Friday)

Uniform: Smart/casual

Probation: 4 months


Main role: To ensure the smooth day to day running of the training centre by ensuring that:

  • A safe and secure environment is provided for our team, our trainees, and any visitors
  • Liaise closely with other departments for trainees’ related activities
  • Train and support internal and external internship providers


1. Programme Planning and Delivery:

  • Collaborate with the multidisciplinary team to plan curriculum, design resources, implement interventions, and set individual targets for trainees.
  • Design and deliver training sessions in line with Steps’ approach which have outcomes that are clear, accessible, motivating, and purposeful to trainees.
  • Collect trainee evidence and data aligned with Steps’ accredited curriculum (e.g., ASDAN, TPQI, BTEC).
  • Actively participate in ongoing meetings for programme and BU development and projects.
  • Collect trainee data and conduct assessments using Steps’ in-house tools to track progress.


2. Supporting Trainees, Internal and External Collaboration:

  • Collaborate with schools and employers on projects that offer trainees work experience or community engagement opportunities, such as events, open houses, and workshops.
  • Collaborate with Steps' internal teams, such as the coffee shop and business units, to plan the structure of trainees' work experience sessions, design and create resources, and align with individual targets for each trainee.
  • For trainees under your case management, be responsible for writing reports, forms, evaluations, and meeting formally with families biannually or upon request.
  • Maintain regular communication with trainees’ families via email, phone, or social media platforms like Seesaw. Help ensure there is weekly communication with parents/families whether by email, phone, or social media (Seesaw).
  • Assist trainees at events, workshops, and trips throughout the year, including weekends and after centre hours (see Work Hours below).


3. Programme Development and Leadership

  • Contribute to the development of inclusive training programmes, accessible resources, and meaningful pathways that foster skills for life, employment, and independence, in line with each trainee's individual learning style and capability.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to build and maintain relationships, promoting the Education Unit to parents, guardians, educators, medical professionals, government, and the local community.
  • Develop and implement policies that align with educational standards and legal requirements, such as child protection and safeguarding.
  • Serve as a resource for the company, offering expertise on approaches and support for neurodivergent learners including providing training for internal staff and external stakeholders.


4. Aligning Steps’ Mission and Creating an Inclusive Environment:

  • Promote an environment of acceptance and understanding.
  • Support Steps' mission within the community.
  • Adhere to the approach, beliefs, and framework of Steps.
  • Stay updated with best practices through regular reading of journal articles and studies, and expanding professional expertise through ongoing professional development activities.


Required Qualifications:

  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in inclusive education, teaching, or supporting neurodivergent learners
  • Working proficiency in communication skills in English
  • Skills in designing teaching resources (such as digital skills)


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Inclusive education training
  • Specialised training such as behaviour therapy, CBT (Cognitive Behavioral Therapy), OT (Occupational Therapy), etc.
  • Experience in working collaboratively with professionals
  • Master’s degree in Inclusive Education, Disability Studies, Psychology, or related field.

company.name: Anantara Hotels & Resorts
company.introduction:
Anantara. The word in Sanskrit means "without end"​ and evokes the freedom, movement and harmony that are the spirit of the Anantara experience and culture.


Since the Anantara experience was born in 2001 in Thailand, operating within one of Asia Pacific’s largest lifestyle companies Minor International, we have successfully expanded to Anantara Hotels & Resorts across Vietnam, China, Indonesia, the Maldives, the Middle East and Africa. As a result of our evolution, we attract passionate people looking to discover a meaningful, rewarding career and capitalise on our continued growth.


Our promise to our guests is that Anantara will bring story collecting travellers closer to local cultures and experiences with luxurious and heartfelt hospitality in exotic destinations.


Our promise to our team members is that we will provide a professional and grounded environment, offering growth, development and inspiring future opportunities.


A passion for genuine, heartfelt hospitality is a prerequisite for working with Anantara, as is professionalism and a drive to succeed. Demonstrating just as much character as the hotels and resorts they work in, our team members are the heart and soul of Anantara – providing expertise and grounded hospitality that has made us renowned throughout the world.

rows.title: F&B Attendant - Spice Market
rows.description:

You will be one of the key influencing factors in guest satisfaction, and as such it is your responsibility to ensure that guests are delighted by the quality of service and comfort in our food and beverage outlets. Your main duties and responsibilities are to work as a team within all departments, ensuring the timely and efficient operation of the food and beverage outlets. You will have complete knowledge of the menus, beverages, services and facilities provided by the resort, and continuously develop your professional skills to further increase guest satisfaction. You will ensure a safe & hygienic work area, and uphold the privacy rights of the guests.


Qualifications


  • High School Diploma or Hospitality training related qualification
  • Previous experience in Food & Beverage/Restaurant operations
  • Passion for excellent service
  • Excellent team player
  • English and Thai speaking

  • Passion for leadership and teamwork.
  • Eye for detail to achieve operational excellence.
  • Understand F&B trends in Bangkok Market
  • Excellent guest service skills.

rows.title: Safety Officer Professional Level (จป.วิชาชีพ)
rows.description:
Key responsibilities


  • Inspect and recommend actions to comply with the laws on safety, occupational health, and the work environment.
  • Analyze work to identify hazards, recommend preventive measures, and implement safe work procedures in the organization.
  • Assess Occupational Health, safety and Work Environment risks.
  • Analyze work plans or projects and recommend occupational health and safety measures to management based on recommendations from various departments.
  • Educate and drive employees to follow the company's occupational health and safety manual.
  • Ensure that employees comply with regulations and manuals on occupational health, safety, and the work environment of the company.
  • Advocate and drive training of employees on work health and safety to ensure a safe work environment by eliminating potential hazards.
  • Measure and evaluate the work environment risks and/or collaborate with individuals or legal entities registered or licensed to do so in accordance with the law on Occupational Health, Safety and Work Environment, or other relevant laws.
  • Take accountability to assist the company to implement appropriate occupational health and safety management procedures in the workplace and continuously develop these to ensure effectiveness.
  • Investigate the causes of injuries, illnesses, or work-related incidents and promptly report the inspection results to the company’s management, along with suggestions for preventing future incidents.
  • Collect statistics, prepare reports, and provide recommendations on work-related hazards, illnesses, or incidents to the company’s management.
  • Ensure onboarding of new employees on occupational and environmental illnesses/risks before commencing work and during work, with periodic knowledge reviews at least once a year.
  • Perform other safety-related tasks as assigned by the company.


Qualifications


  • Thai nationality
  • Minimum two (2) years experience as Safety Officer at the Professional Level or any of the professional level occupational safety officer qualifications approved by the Ministry of Labor in accordance with B.E. 2565 (2022), Article 21
  • Knowledge of Thailand Health and Safety Regulations
  • Knowledge of Hotel Business
  • Excellent training and communication skills (Thai & English)
  • Ability to write and maintain Safety Manual and Occupational Safety Standard Operating Procedures
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, and PowerPoint)

rows.title: Commis II - Shintaro
rows.description:
Job Description


Like all members of the kitchen team, the Commis Chef must maintain high standards of health and safety, including personal hygiene. You will be responsible for producing the most creative and excellent dishes, ensuring that the guests expectations are exceeded and fully satisfied. The person in this position must be able to effectively communicate with other members of the kitchen team, this includes being able to gracefully receive constructive criticism as well as effectively carry out orders. Additionally, a Commis Chef also needs to be able to remain calm while multi-tasking, as they are often called upon to carry out many different orders simultaneously in a brief amount of time. The Commis Chef is a part of the kitchen team, and as such must be able and willing to perform the basic tasks of food preparation and organization in the kitchen. This ability to create excellence in your own area of responsibility and to support others as they do the same is vital to the successful operation of the kitchen and to ensure the enjoyment of guests.


Qualifications


  • High School diploma
  • Passion for teamwork
  • Excellent guest service skills
  • Knowledge of basic preparation, presentation and preservation of food
  • Basic knowledge of hygiene and safety procedures

Since the Anantara experience was born in 2001 in Thailand, operating within one of Asia Pacific’s largest lifestyle companies Minor International, we have successfully expanded to Anantara Hotels & Resorts across Vietnam, China, Indonesia, the Maldives, the Middle East and Africa. As a result of our evolution, we attract passionate people looking to discover a meaningful, rewarding career and capitalise on our continued growth.


Our promise to our guests is that Anantara will bring story collecting travellers closer to local cultures and experiences with luxurious and heartfelt hospitality in exotic destinations.


Our promise to our team members is that we will provide a professional and grounded environment, offering growth, development and inspiring future opportunities.


A passion for genuine, heartfelt hospitality is a prerequisite for working with Anantara, as is professionalism and a drive to succeed. Demonstrating just as much character as the hotels and resorts they work in, our team members are the heart and soul of Anantara – providing expertise and grounded hospitality that has made us renowned throughout the world.

  • Passion for excellence in service and team-work
  • Eye for detail to achieve operational excellence
  • Determination to succeed
  • Excellent English skills

rows.title: F&B Sales Executive (F&B Concierge)
rows.description:
Company Description


A luxury hospitality brand for modern travellers, Anantara connects guests to genuine places, people and stories through personal experiences and providing heartfelt hospitality in the world’s most exciting destinations. From pristine islands and tropical beaches to cosmopolitan cities, tranquil deserts and lush jungles, Anantara welcomes guests for journeys rich in discovery.

Job Description


The position of F&B Sales Executive (F&B Concierge) in the hotel is unique and challenging. He/She performs multiple roles: as an information provider, diplomat, salesperson, ticket manager, hotel representative and public relation agent. They need to perform their duties with the utmost politeness, efficiency, and friendliness as we aim to continually exceed our guest’s expectation.


The F&B Sales Executive (F&B Concierge) is required to spend time in different areas of the hotel to provide information on daily F&B and hotel activities, and sell those activities. A positive attitude, full knowledge of the hotel and attention to detail are traits which our officers are required to have.


A F&B Sales Executive (F&B Concierge) is responsible for creating an atmosphere around his/her desk that welcomes people. The purpose is to communicate, to satisfy a tremendous need for personal service and develop a true sense of community.


Qualifications


  • Previous experience in Food & Beverage/Restaurant operations
  • Excellent upselling skills
  • Passion for excellent service
  • Positive attitude and attention to detail
  • Good English speaking, listening and reading skills

company.name: Ampverse
company.introduction:
Ampverse is playing a different game.

Ampverse Group is a prominent gaming and entertainment ecosystem with 600+ million fans, 300+ client partnerships, and offices across Southeast Asia & India. Founded in 2019 in Singapore and established by former executives from Universal Music Group, Twitch, and Havas.

rows.title: Head of Business Development
rows.description:
Key Responsibilities

  • Work alongside the executive team to develop and execute the strategic sales, sponsorship, and client solutions go-to-market plans.
  • Manage a sales, sponsorship, and client solutions team that can generate business growth across all customer segments 
  • Support the development of new commercial products to evolve and grow our product offering in the market
  • Responsible for the sustainable growth of the business by increasing revenue year-on-year
  • Ensure the performance and strategy of the organization's revenue-generating departments
  • Track & manage revenue pipeline and deliver regular forecasts
  • Participate in contract negotiations adhering to commercial targets
  • Evolve the methods and tools used to measure, report, and recommend improvements in sales and operations effectiveness and enablement
  • Invest in and support ongoing training and enablement for front-line team members
  • Partner with Sales for account planning exercises, QBRs, and upfront negotiations to evaluate client business needs
  • Maintain and approve policy exception requests relating to Service Level Agreements, Pricing, Makegoods, and more
  • Conduct regular status meetings with cross-functional teams to maintain alignment that supports the business
  • Oversee completion of CS team recurring tasks, including pipeline hygiene, campaign pacing, production tracking, measurement outcomes, and client billing
  • Assess staffing needs and lead the interviewing, hiring, and onboarding of talent
  • Lead training for the CS team, inclusive of role-specific, soft-skills, procedural, and developmental training
  • Work with the marketing team to actively shape and implement B2B marketing initiatives such as client events and industry thought leadership.


We’d love to hear from you if…

  • You have 10+ years of sales/revenue/business development management experience, ideally in a high-growth environment. 
  • You possess strong communication skills, the ability to manage and influence direct and indirect reports, a high motivation for continuous improvement, and the ability to drive impact.
  • You have sales leadership experience in relevant sectors and/or industries - esports/gaming, influencer marketing, entertainment industry, and media publishing.
  • You enjoy leading from the front and evangelizing your company and product on the public stage.
  • You have hands-on sales leadership experience and a strong network across Thailand.
  • You have experience building and selling custom content and/or sponsorship solutions vs purely transactional products.
  • You are empathetic and a natural connector - both internally and externally.
  • You’ve got experience architecting and managing revenue systems with CRM software daily.
  • You are naturally curious and demonstrate strong analytical skills 
  • You are client-focused - you like to deliver solutions to client problems
  • You have strong leadership skills
  • You are used to working in a fast-paced environment
  • You are ambitious - You want to win, play for the best team, and be the best version of yourself always
  • You have a track record of hiring and leading diverse teams and a passion for people management and professional development
  • You’re able to remain focused and organized in a dynamic environment, bringing order to chaos and driving execution


Perks

  • Healthy Work-Life Balance—We offer our staff a flexible working routine around target achievement that allows them to take care of their kids or parents, grow as individuals, and stay mentally healthy while achieving big tasks.
  • Targeted but flexible Learning and Development Plans—We want our staff to continue their learning path independently of their hierarchical or experience level. "We never stop learning and developing." Should there be something you want to develop yourself towards, we support you with that!
  • Goal-driven and inclusive - We practice flat hierarchies and value everyone's opinion. We stay focused on our goals using a proven systematic approach like OKRs. We value leadership and teamwork. We believe in the concept of "Imperfect people working perfectly together."
  • Performance-based incentives—We incentivize our teams and employees based on their performance. We ensure that you grow with your challenges and are incentivized competitively.
  • Competitive Health insurance - We offer competitive health insurance for all staff, ensuring one is financially protected from the unexpected.
  • We have fun along the way! Working hard and playing hard in the entertainment industry is critical to our company’s culture. We regularly celebrate with social gatherings, happy hours, and gaming events.

rows.title: Managing Director, Marketing Solutions - Southeast Asia
rows.description:
Requirements

  • A minimum of 8 years of experience in digital marketing and advertising agencies, ideally with a focus on gaming and activating marketing solutions for the gaming industry.
  • At least 5 years of managerial experience within an agency or in house setting, which includes overseeing direct reports.
  • A proven track record of effectively implementing digital marketing services with a comprehensive understanding of integrated agency services.
  • The ability to confidently communicate with clients at all levels, from C-Level executives down, providing in-depth knowledge of Ampverse services and solutions within the context of a client's business.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in managing a team consisting of sales, creative, digital strategists, and account managers.
  • The capacity to manage team utilization efficiently with a target of achieving an average billable utilization rate of 100%.
  • Hands-on experience working in fast-growing startups, proven track record in company building, specifically in scaling an existing local workforce to achieve exceptional results while upholding cultural and emotional cohesion
  • Exceptional skills in analysis, writing, communication, and presentation.


Managing Director's Key Objectives & Metrics


  • Own the Southeast Asia P&L for marketing solutions division
  • Maximize client retention, particularly top-tier clients. 
  • Achieve net revenue growth from existing client accounts. 
  • Maximize team member's career progression, particularly key team members. 
  • Deliver exceptional client service that leads to elevated client satisfaction, demonstrated through client testimonials, case studies, NPS scores, and client referrals. 
  • Optimize the utilization of professional development budgets to enhance team efficiency, success, and retention.


Client Service: Delight & Elevate


  • You will be actively engaged in key client accounts, with billable time primarily allocated to client meetings, relationship development, documentation, service reviews, and general account oversight. 
  • Together with the account team, your responsibilities will focus on enhancing client retention and growth.

 

Team Management & Growth


  • Efficiently manage team capacity to maximize utilization while maintaining service quality and team satisfaction. 
  • Ensure the deployment of the account team for all new and existing client projects. 
  • Collaborate with the Executive Team to leverage the unique talents and abilities of account teams within the agency's structure, ensuring the effective delivery of services and alignment with client needs and preferences. 
  • Guide the professional development of the account team, digital strategists, and digital specialists, using the professional development budget to attend conferences and events, and creating actionable individual development plans (IDPs) to support team members' growth within the company and as industry experts (with a target of 100% IDP goal achievement). 
  • Provide support, both personally and professionally, to all team members, serving as the daily go-to resource for their needs, achievements, and challenges. 
  • Conduct annual performance reviews and make compensation recommendations with feedback from the Executive Team, involving the Executive Team as needed.

Agency Management


  • Work closely with the Executive Team to establish, communicate, and execute Ampverse's vision, mission, and overall strategic direction. 
  • Collaborate with the Operations Manager to ensure the accurate and appropriate utilization of business intelligence, such as:
  • Ensuring the precision of capacity and revenue projections.
  • Managing the team to achieve 100% capacity utilization, including strategic, non-billable activities.
  • Ensuring the accuracy of monthly invoicing and time entry across all clients. Support agency hiring, making key decisions in partnership with the Executive Team. As a supervisory position, the Managing Director will be responsible for coaching the account team in effective service delivery and representing the agency to clients, partners, and peers.


Sales & Business Development


  • Manage a team of sales professionals as well as support the leadership team in sales and business development efforts by taking the lead on select prospects and proposals, providing feedback on proposals, and participating in meetings as required. Generate leads through speaking engagements, writing opportunities, and networking activities.


Marketing, Industry Leadership & Professional Development


  • Contribute insights on industry issues through Ampverse's blog and industry publications. Represent Ampverse at industry conferences and other events, both as a speaker and an attendee.


Your role as Managing Director for Southeast Asia is pivotal in driving revenue growth, client satisfaction, and team success. We look forward to your leadership and contributions to Ampverse's continued success.


Perks

  • Healthy Work-Life Balance - We manage to offer our staff a flexible working routine around target achievement that allows them to take care of their kids or parents, grow as an individual and stay mentally healthy while achieving big tasks
  • Targeted but flexible Learning & Development Plans - We want our staff to continue their learning path independently of their hierarchical or experience level "We never stop learning and developing". Should there be something you wanna develop yourself towards - We support you with that!
  • Goal-driven and inclusive - We practice flat hierarchies and value everyone's opinion. We stay focused on our goals using a proven systematic approach like OKRs. We value leadership and teamwork. We believe in the concept of "Imperfect people working perfectly together"
  • Performance-based incentives - We incentivize our teams and employees based on their performance. We make sure you grow with your challenges and get incentivized competitively
  • Competitive Health insurance - We offer competitive health insurance for all staff that assures one is financially protected from the unexpected
  • We have fun along the way! - As we work in the entertainment industry, work hard and playing hard is key to our company’s culture. We celebrate together with social gatherings, happy hours, and gaming events regularly.

  • Accountability for product planning, forecasting of saleable, collaterals, samples by working closely with demand planning team through 24-month planning, NPD forecast and S&OP meeting to ensure product availability throughout the year.
  • Drive communication & PR strategy to gain awareness, engagement and brand love with PR executive, as well working with external PR agency to expand stronger brand networking.
  • Build owned media platform to create strong engagement between brand and consumers with social executive. Be able to identify effective type of content for the brand and content pillar that relevant to target audience and align with launch direction.
  • Work with media agency to scale up media coverage & brand visibility through media strategy for overall brand & product launch. Review media performance from top-to-lower funnel based on weekly basis and be able to recommend next step for the best media efficiency.

  • Drive productivity and service skills of ELEMIS Pro with Retail Manager, Field Coach, Retail Operation and Training Manager
  • Oversee day-to-day execution, trade activities including analysis on results in order to catch up with market competitiveness and recommend further actions
  • Develop ELEMIS Pro & Therapist competency with Training Manager and Field Coach through brand training protocol and evaluate their performance with constructive development plan every quarter
  • Take ownership by work with Visual Merchandising Manager (local & regional) to create the best customer journey & visual impact for focused product
  • Partner with department store and Key Account Manager to leverage store performance and uplift sales opportunity, request visibility and partnership

  • Orchestrate 360 communication with e-Business plan to create seamless customer journey
  • Work closely with eCommerce Manager, enabler, and media agency to drive qualified & quantified traffic to platform, manage promo, visibility and media performance


SPA

  • Support APAC SPA Director to drive SPA sales through marketing activation/support (i.e., event, VM)
  • Coordinate with local team to facilitate local operation (PO, Tester, Training support) to ensure customer satisfaction and smooth operation
  • Be the main contact point to facilitate on importation & licensing


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or master’s degree in business administration, marketing, strategy or any related field.
  • 7+ years of experience in brand management, preferably in the luxury beauty or skincare retail industry
  • Strong command of communication in English
  • Has extensive experience of sales, operations, and training.
  • Proven ability to oversee all sales and operational activities.
  • Experience in strategic planning and executive.
  • Knowledge of structuring sales quota, commission scheme and revenue expectations
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication and interpersonal skills
  • Sales drive and results focus.
  • People management experience
  • Coaching and counselling skills
  • Thoroughness in problem solving
  • Setting priorities in tasks planning
  • Analytical mindset

rows.title: CRM & Product Marketing Executive
rows.description:
Key accountabilities :


CRM

  • Analyze data to provide strategic advice to internal management on implementing initiatives that enhance customer experience and response to marketing campaigns and channel preferences.
  • Initiate, plan, and lead the execution of loyalty program for both online and retail stores across multiple CRM channels to increase customer lifetime value and improve all key aspects, which are recruitment, repeat purchase and retention.
  • Identify customer needs and behavior and define CRM strategy and customer cultivation plan to uplift customer experience.
  • Support cross functional teams by performing detailed analysis of customer behavior, uncovering vital insights, identifying key target groups, and assessing the impact of customer engagement and marketing strategies.
  • Implement triggered and automated lifecycle journeys, utilizing email and SMS messaging by leveraging data to drive performance.
  • Monitor, analyze, and report the effectiveness of marketing campaigns, using a range of variables and assumptions to guide strategic decisions, optimize future campaigns and improve ROI.
  • Leverage marketing automation tools and CRM systems to streamline processes and enhance campaign effectiveness.
  • Plan and implement omnichannel campaigns with strategy to introduce online platform to offline customers and reverse to always improve omni-channel customer rate.
  • Work with CRM and loyalty agency and regional team for brand campaign planning and implementation.


Product Marketing

  • Identify market needs and trends to develop category and product strategy to achieve KPI and sales which align with business goals and manage portfolio to accelerate the business growth.
  • Work collaboratively with supply chain on demand forecast and ensure timely product launch as per marketing calendar.
  • Actively review stocks, GWP, samples for excess inventory, expired and aged stocks and provide recommendation on next step.
  • Work collaboratively with VM and Sales team on store planogram optimization. Rationalize product assortment and plan based on sales and strategy.
  • Support marketing manager to develop and implement comprehensive marketing plans for new product launch and existing products.
  • Co-ordinate and collaborate with a diverse team to manage end-to-end campaign execution – delivering in full and on-time campaign executions across all channels.
  • Plan product strategy and allocation to create omni-channel momentum.


Qualifications and Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, or a related field.

rows.title: Material Planner
rows.description:
Responsibilities

  • Generate and maintain material requirements planning (MRP) schedules based on production forecasts, customer orders and inventory policies.
  • Coordinate with supplier to ensure timely delivery of materials, negotiating terms and managing supplier relationships.
  • Monitor inventory levels and track material usage to optimize stock levels and minimize shortages.
  • Collaborate with operation, RD and procurement teams to resolve material availability issues and support production schedules.
  • Utilize ERP/MRP system to track inventory levels, orders, and shipment accurately.
  • Prepare and communicate material status report and forecasts to stakeholders, highlighting potential risks and opportunities.
  • Develop and submit monthly rolling material purchasing forecasts to suppliers, ensuring they have the capacity and materials to fulfill forecasted requirements. Raise red flags if suppliers may not meet the demand.
  • Assist in NPD (New Product Development), VE, Cost+ by coordinating material readiness and ensuring timely availability of components.
  • Ensure accuracy of data in MRP systems and maintain documentation in compliance with organizational standards.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives related to material planning processes and operational efficiency.
  • Adjust material orders and inventory level in response to changes in production schedules, customer demand or design changes to ensure optimal inventory levels.
  • Proactively tune up and tune down material supply to align with production needs, avoiding excess inventory (write off) or shortages.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Economics, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration or a related field. A master’s degree is a plus.
  • Minimum 2-5 years proven experiences in Material Requirement Planning, Production Scheduling, Supply Chain Management, preferably within a manufacturing environment.
  • Strong knowledge and practical experience in Material Requirement Planning (MRP), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) and proficiency with MS office tools (Excel, Power point) for data analysis and presentation.
  • Familiarity with lean manufacturing principles and continuous improvement methodologies that enhance operational efficiency without over complicating processes.
  • Understand of supply chain risk management strategies and regulatory requirements relevant to the manufacturing industry.
  • Intermediate to advanced proficiency in Excel for data manipulation and analysis supporting decision-making and process optimization.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, anticipate trend and make informed decisions.
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills enabling collaboration with cross-functional teams, customers and suppliers.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and deadline in a dynamic environment, maintaining composure under pressure.
  • Detail-oriented with organizational skills ensuring accuracy in data management and reporting.
  • Proactive in finding and implementing simple, efficient improvement to processes.

  • ติดต่อลูกค้าตามแผนการโทรเพื่อให้ความรู้และข้อมูลผลิตภัณฑ์สำหรับผู้บริโภค รักษาลูกค้าปัจจุบัน และสร้างความสัมพันธ์ใหม่กับลูกค้า
  • ติดตามการโทรกับลูกค้าเพื่อทำความเข้าใจการใช้ผลิตภัณฑ์ทั้งหมดของทีมโภชนาการ
  • ทำการสำรวจผู้บริโภคเพื่อทำความเข้าใจข้อมูลเชิงลึกของผู้บริโภคตามความต้องการทางการตลาด 
  • บันทึกข้อมูลการโทรทั้งหมดในระบบและแชร์รายงานรายเดือนให้กับทีมรวมถึงข้อมูลเชิงลึกที่สำคัญของผู้บริโภค 
  • วางแผนและดำเนินการเพื่อกระตุ้นยอดขาย
  • รับโทรศัพท์และให้คำแนะนำตามความรู้ผลิตภัณฑ์ ให้คำปรึกษาปัญหาแม่และเด็ก และปัญหาอื่นๆ ที่เกี่ยวข้องตามข้อกังวล และบันทึกผลลงในระบบ
  • ตอบคำถามในเว็บไซต์อีคอมเมิร์ซและโซเชียลคอมเมิร์ซ (Lazada, Shoppee, Line@, Tiktok, FB Official store) ตามคำขอและโดยเร็วที่สุดเพื่อรักษาระดับการให้บริการของคะแนนเว็บไซต์
  • จัดการกับข้อร้องเรียนของลูกค้าโดยให้ข้อมูลที่เป็นประโยชน์และประสานงานกับผู้ที่เกี่ยวข้องเพื่อแก้ไขปัญหาของลูกค้าและสร้างความพึงพอใจสูงสุดให้กับลูกค้า
  • สนับสนุนทีมการตลาดเพื่อให้บรรลุเป้าหมายการขายโดยการติดตามการโทร โครงการการตลาดและรายงานสรุป เช่น โปรแกรม Loyalty
  • ประสานงานกับคลังสินค้าเพื่อจัดส่งตัวอย่างผลิตภัณฑ์ โบรชัวร์ และหนังสือเล่มเล็กให้กับลูกค้า
  • รวบรวมข้อมูลลูกค้าและผลการติดต่อทั้งหมดเพื่อทำรายงานและส่งทุกเดือนหรือตามคำขอ


คุณสมบัติ  

  • จบปริญญาตรี สาขา Nutrition, Food Science, Food Technology, Business Management จะพิจารณาเป็นพิเศษ
  • มีประสบการณ์ Telesales หรือ Call Center อย่างน้อย 1-2 ปี ทางด้านอาหารเพื่อสุขภาพ โภชนาการ อาหารเสริม ยา หรืออุตสาหกรรมทางการแพทย์ จะพิจารณาเป็นพิเศษ
  • มีใจรักในการขายสินค้า.
  • สามารถทำงานภายใต้แรงกดดันเพื่อให้บรรลุเป้าหมายการขายและเข้าใจงาน Telesales
  • มีทักษะในการโน้มน้าวใจและปิดการขาย
  • มีความมุ่งมั่นในการบรรลุเป้าหมายการขาย และสามารถจูงใจตนเองด้วยเงินและเป้าหมายการขาย
  • มีความมั่นใจในการพูดคุยกับคนแปลกหน้าทางโทรศัพท์โดยไม่ลังเล
  • สามารถเดินทางไปทำงานที่ออฟฟิศได้ (ไม่มีนโยบาย WFH)
  • มีทัศนคติเชิงบวก “CAN DO” มีความมุ่งมั่น มีใจรักการบริการ
  • มีทักษะในการประสานงานและการสื่อสารที่ดี
  • สามารถทำงานได้ด้วยตัวเองและมีความรับผิดชอบสูง
  • สามารถใช้คอมพิวเตอร์ได้ดี (MS Office : MS Word, Excel, Power Point)

3. Knowledge of corresponding materials, production processes, technical requirements, cost structures, etc.

4. Professional integrity, strong work execution, strong sense of responsibility, and excellent negotiation skills.

5. Have good learning ability and enterprising spirit, good communication skills and teamwork skills;

company.introduction: Hilton Hotels & Resorts is a global brand of full-service hotels and resorts and the flagship brand of American multinational hospitality company Hilton.

rows.title: Guest Service Supervisor
rows.description:
What will I be doing?

As a Guest Service Executive, you are part of the Front Office Team which is the main connection between Guests, the Hotel and the various hotel departments. You are responsible for performing the following tasks to the highest standards:

  • Assign and instruct Guest Service Agents, Operators and Bell Attendants in details of work
  • Manage front desk operations by completing a checklist of important daily tasks, determining room and rate availability and making decisions that are in the best interest of the hotel.
  • Assist Guest Service Agents, Operators, Reservation Agents, Bell Attendants and other departments with any questions or requests
  • Resolve customer complaints by conducting thorough investigation of the situation and coming up with the most effective resolution
  • Prepare and conduct daily pre-shift meetings, communicate effectively with all staff and provide them with any information necessary to provide guest service in accordance with Hilton Standards
  • Perform other duties assigned by the Front Office Manager or Assistant Front Office Manager
  • Respond promptly to guest requests for a supervisor or manager
  • Ensure that a detailed hand over is carried out between shifts including the volume of business, special guests, tasks to be clarified/completed and any special events that are taking place
  • Ensure a high level of product knowledge of the hotel and the local area, and know what is happening in the hotel
  • Ensure our customers receive a fast, efficient and friendly check in and check out
  • Ensure all customers’ queries or requests are handled in a polite, efficient manner and a high level of customer service is consistently maintained
  • Preparation and co-ordination of group arrivals/departures.
  • Ensure a good performance oriented working environment within the department and motivate the staff
  • Participate regularly in training courses and put the skills learned there into practice
  • Receives payment by cash, credit cards, cheques, etc. and is able to post these in the computer correctly
  • Have detailed knowledge of the fire, safety and evacuation procedures of the hotel
  • Have knowledge of all the equipment and installations on the Executive Floor, and able to work there independently in conformity with the established standard and take over shifts if necessary


What are we looking for?

A Guest Service Executive serving Hilton Brand hotels is always working on behalf of our Guests and working with other Team Members. To successfully fill this role, you should maintain the attitude, behaviours, skills, and values that follow:

  • Ability to effectively deal with internal and external customers, some of whom will require high levels of patience, tact and diplomacy to defuse anger, collect accurate information to resolve conflicts
  • Basic mathematical skills and considerable skill in the use and operation of a calculator to prepare complex mathematical calculations without error
  • Ability to listen effectively and comprehend the English language to understand and obtain instructions and information
  • Ability to see and hear in order to observe and detect signs of emergency situations

rows.title: Learning & Development Supervisor
rows.description:
What will I be doing?

As L&D Supervisor you will be responsible for performing the following tasks to the highest standards:

  • Update the training notice board with all information on the situation in and out of the hotel as well as training information.
  • Assist in the implementation of recognition programs.
  • Organize a coordinate approved cross trainings.
  • Carry out talent programs according to brand standards.
  • Assist to set up and maintain training and talent program policies.
  • Develop plans to conduct needs analyses and in-house training on a regular basis.
  • Propose training plans and ensure that all training records are in place.
  • Develop tools and systems to ensure training and development programs meet hotel objectives.
  • Ensure that training and development are integrated into business plans and budgets, and targeted goals are identified and monitored.
  • Take part in the preparation and planning of the Training department’s goals and objectives.
  • Facilitate the implementation of multi-skill programs.
  • Manage the planning and delivery of orientation programs.
  • Offer support and advice on personal development plans to team members under your supervision.
  • Implement appropriate management practices that provide team members with motivation and communication.
  • Provide information as required regarding training records and attendance.
  • Assist all departmental trainers with their training where necessary.
  • Deal effectively with guests and workplace colleagues from a variety of cultures.
  • Be aware of duty of care, and adhere to occupational health and safety legislations, policies and procedures.
  • Adhere to the hotel’s security and emergency policies and procedures.
  • Be familiar with property safety, current first aid and fire emergency procedures.
  • Ensure that all team members have a complete understanding of and adhere to the hotel’s team member rules and regulations.
  • Carry out any other reasonable duties and responsibilities as assigned.
  • The Management reserves the right to make changes to this job description at its sole discretion and without advance notice.


What are we looking for?

L&D Supervisor, serving Hilton Brands is always working on behalf of our Guests and working with other Team Members. To successfully fill this role, you should maintain the attitude, behaviours, skills, and values that follow:

  • University graduate.
  • Minimum 2 years of related working experience in the hotel industry.
  • Have management experience in a training supervisory or above role, in an international 5-star hotel.
  • Excellent command of written and spoken English to meet business needs.
  • Good communication skills.
  • Knowledgeable of Learning & Development.
  • Good presentation and teaching skills.
  • Good project management skills.
  • Excellent coordination and organization ability.
